alwaysOn.title: Writing rules
alwaysOn.description: Things that work in every note with nothing to switch on: folds, checkboxes, footnotes, callouts.

blurbs.heading-and-paragraph: A heading and a paragraph as one section, with an optional background.
blurbs.image-grid: A table of photos, names and roles becomes a grid of people.
blurbs.image-text: An image beside text, as one section. Stacks on a phone.
blurbs.photo-grid: A list of images becomes a tidy photo grid.
blurbs.quotes-stack: Quote cards from a short list: quote, name, date, color.
blurbs.services: A title, a sentence and a list, as a two-column section.
blurbs.slideshow: A row of images that scrolls by on its own.
blurbs.testimonials: Quotes with a name and role, shown one at a time.
